bifrost: none for 3D. Nearest code: springboard/src/gpu/batch.rs (2D quad vertex batch), springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (PNG/JPEG decode), springboard/ui/src/anim.rs (2D property animation)
summary: Model I/O covers 3D asset import and export, meshes, materials, lights, cameras, skeletal animation and mesh processing. BifrOSt has no 3D model, mesh, material, light or camera layer in the shell, the SDK or the renderer, and no 3D asset format is registered, so every feature here is a gap. The GPU presenter draws only 2D quads.

features.note: Headless tests in parity_sdk-tests-18 cover the named-node arena: paths, hidden subtrees, depth-first order and refused names. The module is not wired into apps or the shell, and it has no asset loader, so no 3D file format is read.

features.apple: MDLTransform, MDLTransformStack, MDLTransformOp and its rotate/scale/translate/matrix subclasses
features.note: Headless tests in parity_sdk-tests-18 cover operation order, translation, scale, rotation, matrix operations and parent composition of local transforms. Gap: no renderer consumes the transform stack, and the rotate, scale and translate forms are one enum rather than separate types.

features.apple: MDLMesh, MDLSubmesh, MDLSubmeshTopology, MDLVertexDescriptor, MDLVertexAttribute, MDLVertexAttributeData, MDLVertexBufferLayout
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 19 tests. Wave 2 (theme-09, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. the GPU vertex code only draws 2D triangles, no mesh type, index buffer or attribute layout is exposed to apps

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 13 tests. Wave 5 (theme-20, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no app-facing buffer allocator

Named material properties with base inheritance and the CPU shading model are tested in ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-19.rs. Gap: the material and shading models are not joined, textures are stored as paths only, and window vibrancy stays a compositor effect.

features.apple: MDLTexture, MDLURLTexture, MDLTextureSampler, MDLTextureFilter, procedural textures (checkerboard, noise, sky cube, normal map)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 5 (w5-model-i-o, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. images decode, but there are no samplers, mip filters or procedural generators

Wave 4 (w4-model-i-o, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; headless tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-04.rs cover the point, spot, directional and ambient falloff and the types left uncomputed. Not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Name match only

Projection validity, the look and framing operations and the view and projection matrices are tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-42.rs. Not yet wired into apps or the shell and not tested on Midget; webcam capture is not a 3D view camera.

features.feature: Sharing buffers with the GPU framework
features.apple: interop with MetalKit, GLKit and SceneKit (framework overview)
features.note: The layout of a buffer shared with the GPU (size, pixel format, row stride, exact length) and the fourcc and modifier pair a device imports it with are tested headless. Gap: no export or import call is wired to a device, and no 3D consumer exists on Linux, so the lab machine must confirm the dma-buf round trip.

gaps: 3D scene graph: no MDLAsset or MDLObject equivalent, and no 3D transform stack
Mesh data: no vertex descriptor, index buffer, submesh or buffer allocator exposed to apps
Material and shading model: no material properties, scattering functions or physically based lights
Import and export of 3D formats (OBJ, USD, PLY, STL, Alembic) and no 3D UTTypes in springboard/ui/src/uttype.rs
Skeletal animation (skeletons, joints, animated quaternions) and keyframe animation
Procedural texture generators, texture samplers and mip filters for 3D surfaces
Mesh processing: subdivision, ambient occlusion baking, light probe generation
Asset resolver protocols (MDLAssetResolver and its path, relative and bundle implementations)
